text:
maya: Heads-up: found a repro in the Go sampleapp where generator streaming + auth refresh creates duplicated chunks.

sam: Ugh. How reproducible?

maya: Very. Start the sample generator with a long stream (~30-90s). Force token expiry mid-stream (I revoked a test token). The client transport does 401->refresh->retry and the server ends up emitting the same stream twice. App shows duplicate events.

lina: Sounds like the retry wrapper is transparently replaying the handshake instead of failing fast. Do you have the minimal code?

maya: Yep. This is what the sampleapp uses:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Minute)
defer cancel()
stream, err := client.Generator().GenerateStream(ctx, req)
if err != nil { return err }
defer stream.Close()
for c := range stream.Chunks() {
  // forward to socket
}
```
The transport retry is at RoundTripper level and reissues the request using the same outer ctx, so the original handshake keeps running on the server.

ajay: Does Close() cancel the underlying request? If the retry is racing, Close() may only shut local readers.

maya: Exactly. Close() only closes readers and marks the client stream closed; it doesn't stop an in-progress retry attempt created by the transport. So we can end up with two concurrent server sessions.

lina: Two short-term mitigations: (1) disable handshake retries for streaming endpoints, or (2) ensure each retry attempt gets its own cancellable ctx and we cancel previous attempts before issuing a retry.

sam: We should add an explicit option on the Generator client: GenerateStream(ctx, req, opts) with opts.DisableHandshakeRetry bool. That way sampleapp can opt out by default.

maya: I can prototype that. Plan: update Go SDK to add GenerateStreamWithOpts where DisableHandshakeRetry defaults to true in sampleapp. Also add a unit e2e that simulates 401 during handshake and asserts no duplicates.

ajay: Please open an issue and a PR. Also add a tiny note in the Go onboarding docs describing the caveat (credential rotation during active streams).

redwood-bot: Issue created: #2523 "go: generator stream dupes when auth refresh triggers retry" (assigned to maya).

maya: Will open PR tonight. One design question: should we make server handshake idempotent instead so retries are safe? That would be more robust but is a larger contract change.

lina: Worth drafting an RFC, but treat that as medium-term. For now, client-side opt-out + docs is fine. Also add a diagnostic counter to the SDK to surface "mid-handshake retry" occurrences so SRE can track incidents.

maya: Good call. I'll include metrics and a small sampleapp README update. Ping me if you want to review the PR early. :rocket:
